versos.hebraico: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּ֨ים עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֖וֹ חֶפְצִי־בָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Hephzibah.
controles.kjv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzi–bah.
controles.livre: De doze anos era Manassés quando começou a reinar, e reinou em Jerusalém cinquenta e cinco anos: o nome de sua mãe foi Hefzibá.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּתֽוֹעֲבֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: He did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, segundo as abominações das nações que o SENHOR havia lançado diante dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֗שָׁב וַיִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת־הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִבַּ֖ד חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּ֨קֶם מִזְבְּחֹ֜ת לַבַּ֗עַל וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה אַחְאָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ לְכָל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as did Ahab king of Israel, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.
controles.kjv: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
controles.livre: Porque ele voltou a edificar os altos que Ezequias seu pai havia derrubado, e levantou altares a Baal, e fez bosque, como havia feito Acabe rei de Israel: e adorou a todo o exército do céu, e serviu àquelas coisas.

versos.hebraico: וּבָנָ֥ה מִזְבְּחֹ֖ת בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת־שְׁמִֽי׃

controles.web: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”
controles.kjv: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
controles.livre: Também edificou altares na casa do SENHOR, da qual o SENHOR havia dito: Eu porei meu nome em Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְכָל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בִּשְׁתֵּ֖י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.
controles.kjv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: E edificou altares para todo o exército do céu nos dois átrios da casa do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהֶעֱבִ֤יר אֶת־בְּנוֹ֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְעוֹנֵ֣ן וְנִחֵ֔שׁ וְעָ֥שָׂה א֖וֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִ֑ים הִרְבָּ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִֽיס׃

controles.web: He made his son to pass through the fire, and practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he worked much evil in the sight of Yahweh, to provoke him to anger.
controles.kjv: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.
controles.livre: E passou a seu filho por fogo, e olhou em tempos, e foi agoureiro, e instituiu necromantes e adivinhos, multiplicando assim o fazer o mal aos olhos do SENHOR, para provocá-lo à ira.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֕שֶׂם אֶת־פֶּ֥סֶל הָאֲשֵׁרָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה בַּבַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־דָּוִד֙ וְאֶל־שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֔וֹ בַּבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֨רְתִּי֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: He set the engraved image of Asherah, that he had made, in the house of which Yahweh said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name forever;
controles.kjv: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the Lord said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
controles.livre: E pôs uma imagem entalhada do bosque que ele havia feito, na casa da qual havia o SENHOR dito a Davi e a Salomão seu filho: Eu porei meu nome para sempre nesta casa, e em Jerusalém, à qual escolhi de todas as tribos de Israel:

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֣א אֹסִ֗יף לְהָנִיד֙ רֶ֣גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַֽאֲבוֹתָ֑ם רַ֣ק׀ אִם־יִשְׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ים וּלְכָל־הַ֨תּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם עַבְדִּ֥י מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: neither will I cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”
controles.kjv: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
controles.livre: E não voltarei a fazer que o pé de Israel seja movido da terra que dei a seus pais, contanto que guardem e façam conforme a todas as coisas que eu lhes mandei, e conforme a toda a lei que meu servo Moisés lhes mandou.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַיַּתְעֵ֤ם מְנַשֶּׁה֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֶת־הָרָ֔ע מִן־הַ֨גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הִשְׁמִ֣יד יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: But they didn’t listen: and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the Lord destroyed before the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Mas eles não escutaram; e Manassés os induziu a que fizessem mais mal que as nações que o SENHOR destruiu diante dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR por meio de seus servos os profetas, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֙ הַתֹּעֵב֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה הֵרַ֕ע מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֥וּ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּחֲטִ֥א גַֽם־אֶת־יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּגִלּוּלָֽיו׃פ

controles.web: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has made Judah also to sin with his idols;
controles.kjv: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:
controles.livre: Porquanto Manassés rei de Judá fez estas abominações, e fez mais mal que tudo o que fizeram os amorreus que foram antes dele, e também fez pecar a Judá em seus ídolos;

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִי֙ מֵבִ֣יא רָעָ֔ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וִֽיהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּל־שמעיו תִּצַּ֖לְנָה שְׁתֵּ֥י אָזְנָֽיו׃

controles.web: therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, ‘Behold, I bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah, that whoever hears of it, both his ears shall tingle.
controles.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.
controles.livre: Portanto, assim disse o SENHOR o Deus de Israel: Eis que eu trago tal mal sobre Jerusalém e sobre Judá, que o que o ouvir, lhe retinirão ambos ouvidos.

versos.hebraico: וְנָטִ֣יתִי עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֵ֚ת קָ֣ו שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וְאֶת־מִשְׁקֹ֖לֶת בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וּמָחִ֨יתִי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־יִמְחֶ֤ה אֶת־הַצַּלַּ֨חַת֙ מָחָ֔ה וְהָפַ֖ךְ עַל־פָּנֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
controles.kjv: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
controles.livre: E estenderei sobre Jerusalém o cordel de Samaria, e o prumo da casa de Acabe: e eu limparei a Jerusalém como se limpa um prato, que depois que o limpam, viram-no sobre sua face.

versos.hebraico: וְנָטַשְׁתִּ֗י אֵ֚ת שְׁאֵרִ֣ית נַחֲלָתִ֔י וּנְתַתִּ֖ים בְּיַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָי֥וּ לְבַ֛ז וְלִמְשִׁסָּ֖ה לְכָל־אֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies;
controles.kjv: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
controles.livre: E desampararei os restantes de minha propriedade, e os entregarei em mãos de seus inimigos; e serão para saque e para roubo a todos seus adversários;

versos.hebraico: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֤וּ אֶת־הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וַיִּהְי֥וּ מַכְעִסִ֖ים אֹתִ֑י מִן־הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֤וּ אֲבוֹתָם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”
controles.kjv: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
controles.livre: Porquanto fizeram o mal aos meus olhos, e me provocaram à ira, desde o dia que seus pais saíram do Egito até hoje.

versos.hebraico: וְגַם֩ דָּ֨ם נָקִ֜י שָׁפַ֤ךְ מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־מִלֵּ֥א אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם פֶּ֣ה לָפֶ֑ה לְבַ֤ד מֵֽחַטָּאתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת־יְהוּדָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; besides his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.
controles.livre: Além disso, derramou Manassés muito sangue inocente em grande maneira, até encher a Jerusalém de extremidade a extremidade; além de seu pecado com que fez pecar a Judá, para que fizesse o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י מְנַשֶּׁה֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְחַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
controles.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
controles.livre: Os demais dos feitos de Manassés, e todas as coisas que fez, e seu pecado que cometeu, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מְנַשֶּׁה֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּגַן־בֵּית֖וֹ בְּגַן־עֻזָּ֑א וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

controles.web: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E descansou Manassés com seus pais, e foi sepultado no jardim de sua casa, no jardim de Uzá; e reinou em seu lugar Amom seu filho.

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וּשְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אָמ֣וֹן בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁתַּ֣יִם שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מְשֻׁלֶּ֥מֶת בַּת־חָר֖וּץ מִן־יָטְבָֽה׃

controles.web: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
controles.kjv: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
controles.livre: De vinte e dois anos era Amom quando começou a reinar, e reinou dois anos em Jerusalém. O nome de sua mãe foi Mesulemete filha de Haruz de Jotbá.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה אָבִֽיו׃

controles.web: He did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh, as Manasseh his father did.
controles.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh did.
controles.livre: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, como havia feito Manassés seu pai.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּכָל־הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַ֣ךְ אָבִ֑יו וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֗ד אֶת־הַגִּלֻּלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָבַ֣ד אָבִ֔יו וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לָהֶֽם׃

controles.web: He walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them:
controles.kjv: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
controles.livre: E andou em todos os caminhos em que seu pai andou, e serviu às imundícias às quais havia servido seu pai, e a elas adorou;

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲזֹ֕ב אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א הָלַ֖ךְ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and he abandoned Yahweh, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And he forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.
controles.livre: E deixou ao SENHOR o Deus de seus pais, e não andou no caminho do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְשְׁר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי־אָמ֖וֹן עָלָ֑יו וַיָּמִ֥יתוּ אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.
controles.kjv: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
controles.livre: E os servos de Amom conspiraram contra ele, e mataram ao rei em sua casa.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּךְ֙ עַם־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַקֹּשְׁרִ֖ים עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָמ֑וֹן וַיַּמְלִ֧יכוּ עַם־הָאָ֛רֶץ אֶת־יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

controles.web: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
controles.kjv: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
controles.livre: Então o povo da terra feriu a todos os que haviam conspirado contra o rei Amom; e pôs o povo da terra por rei em seu lugar a Josias seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אָמ֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
controles.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
controles.livre: Os demais dos feitos de Amom, que efetuara, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְבְֹּ֥ר אֹת֛וֹ בִּקְבֻרָת֖וֹ בְּגַן־עֻזָּ֑א וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

controles.web: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E foi sepultado em seu sepulcro no jardim de Uzá, e reinou em seu lugar Josias seu filho.
